editorial.description_en: The first ice of the year, thin enough to see the water through. The palest blue in the corpus and the one closest to being a neutral.
editorial.description_ja: 年のはじめのうすい氷のような、やわらかい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.922, C 0.018, h 232.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 初 (hatsu, first) + 氷 (kōri, ice), rendaku to -gōri. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "First Ice" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 初氷. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — asa-moya at ΔE00 3.6, usu-mizu at ΔE00 4.1, usu-shimo at ΔE00 4.5. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.018 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
